title: Performance of the 10X Genomics flex single-cell sequencing assay and its application to overcome challenges in clinical trial samples.
snippet: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) has become essential for understanding disease biology, yet its application in clinical trials is often limited by logistical challenges associated with the handling of biospecimens.
